interfaces.transport: Same-origin HTTPS assets, /api/session and /api/invoices; native staff sign-in, never a provisioned browser

request.upload: POST /api/invoices with application/pdf bytes, maximum 10000000 bytes; no caller account, storage path/version, destination or action supplied
request.review: POST /api/invoices/{id}/review: exact revision, fields and bounded notes
request.read: GET list/detail/original/history; paginated list/history; recover extraction through supervisor-authorized POST /api/invoices/{id}/recover

interfaces.response: 202 accepted invoice snapshot on upload; subsequent reads show durable review/delivery state. Acceptance is not extraction or external-action completion.
interfaces.identity: Provider-native verified staff identity plus current SQL membership on every operation. Reviewer/supervisor roles come from live membership, never JWT role names or request/document content. JWT revocation is bounded by native token lifetime.
interfaces.authorization: Same-origin checks on mutations, strict scope/account ownership and SQL role-specific function grants. Ordinary uploaders cannot approve. Edits invalidate prior approval; approved payload digest/revision is bound to dispatch.
interfaces.idempotency: Content digest and account/workflow operation identity deduplicate upload/queue work; immutable original version/digest are server-owned. Delivery effects require the separate accounting contract.
interfaces.timeouts: Upload streaming is bounded to 15 seconds and 10 MB; review bodies to 5 seconds and 10000 bytes. Worker/parser execution limits are separate and do not imply an end-to-end SLA.
interfaces.retention: 90-day application access/cleanup eligibility; original versions, native backups and scheduled cleanup have separate lifecycle/restore windows. No exact global erasure promise.

interfaces.transport: Fixed operator-reviewed HTTPS POST, no redirect or proxy-derived destination; existing accounting system remains external
interfaces.identity: Worker-only destination credential; API/parser/operator jobs receive none. Endpoint digest, scope and mapping version are part of the approved snapshot.
interfaces.approval: Only a current allowed approved dispatch with matching operation ID, payload digest, destination contract and result revision can call the adapter.
interfaces.timeouts: 8-second HTTPS connection/read operations with a separate bounded worker/process deadline; no redirect, 202-as-completed or arbitrary error-body logging.
interfaces.idempotency: Canonical approved payload and stable key survive retries. An ambiguous/expired dispatch becomes unknown; automatic replay requires separately reviewed scoped/expiring native accounting idempotency acceptance. A no-request retry cannot erase prior uncertainty.
interfaces.recovery: Supervisor/operator inspect the existing accounting service independently by operation ID/digest before recording a verified completion receipt. Never resend an uncertain action simply to clear a failure.
interfaces.boundary: Generated normalized adapter and local TLS fixtures do not prove compatibility with this actual accounting API. Actual provider credentials, endpoint behavior, idempotency and reconciliation must be accepted separately.

evidenceBoundary: Compiler-defined contracts; actual service behavior, model quality and account access require independent tests.
